backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor stub with no implemented methods.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence metadata listing required UI changes, removed personalization, removed music, and referenced source files.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: High-level descriptions of all frontend files including app behavior, styles, Tailwind config, audio hook, and assets README.
frontend/index.css: Base Tailwind setup defining extensive OKLCH color tokens and light/dark theme variables.
frontend/index.html: Simple HTML wrapper loading the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main UI with fixed Valentine message, dodging No button mechanic, and animated success screen with hearts.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and refreshes an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using Internet Identity.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and hooks for managing Internet Identity login, stored identity, and authentication state.
frontend/src/hooks/useLocalAudio.ts: Empty placeholder file for removed local audio functionality.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Stub file exporting nothing, indicating no backend queries are used.
frontend/src/index.css: Romantic-themed Tailwind base styles with OKLCH palette, custom fonts, and heart animations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React entrypoint initializing QueryClient, InternetIdentityProvider, and rendering App.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with dark mode, custom color tokens, typography, container settings, animations, and extended theme options.
project_state.json: Stores the project’s specification, features, and current build-state metadata for the Valentine website.
